connections.why: The AI laboratories' safety levels are modeled, they say, on the biosafety levels that this argument produced: a stated capability, then a required level of containment before the work goes on.

Scientists meeting at Napa in 2015 over editing the human germ line invoked Asilomar; the summits that followed called He Jiankui's edited twins irresponsible, and in 2023 heritable editing unacceptable.
